versions.changelog:
Anime-drama v1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Automatically converts novel text into vertical-format (9:16) anime-style short videos.
- Complete pipeline: storyboard generation → text-to-image → image-to-video → video merge via ffmpeg.
- Supports input of any novel/story text; splits into scenes automatically.
- Integrates with RunningHub AI for image and video generation.
- Output: MP4 video, 1080×1920 resolution, with robust error handling and resumable workflow.
